headline: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir sworn in as 23rd president of Bangladesh
summary: The swearing-in ceremony took place at Bangabhaban, where four new ministers and two state ministers also took their oaths.
details: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has officially taken the oath of office as the 23rd President of Bangladesh at Bangabhaban.
During the same ceremony, four new ministers and two state ministers were also sworn in to join the cabinet.
The event marks a significant transition in the country's leadership, with the new president and ministers assuming their roles.
International leaders, including the presidents of India and Pakistan, have already sent their congratulations to President Mirza Fakhrul.
The Pakistani president has also extended an invitation for a visit to Pakistan.
The new ministers join a cabinet led by Tarique Rahman, although their specific portfolios are currently pending.
caption:
Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is now the 23rd President of Bangladesh.

Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has officially taken the oath of office as the 23rd President of Bangladesh at Bangabhaban.

During the same ceremony, four new ministers and two state ministers were also sworn in to join the cabinet.

The event marks a significant transition in the country's leadership, with the new president and ministers assuming their roles.

International leaders, including the presidents of India and Pakistan, have already sent their congratulations to President Mirza Fakhrul.

The Pakistani president has also extended an invitation for a visit to Pakistan.

The new ministers join a cabinet led by Tarique Rahman, although their specific portfolios are currently pending.

headline: Six new ministers take oath in first cabinet reshuffle
summary: Four ministers and two state ministers have been sworn in at Bangabhaban, bringing new faces to the Tarique-led cabinet.
details: Four new ministers and two state ministers took their oath of office at Bangabhaban in the first cabinet reshuffle.
The new appointments include Moin Khan for Local Government, Partha for Information, and Millat for Aviation.
caption:
New faces in the cabinet! Six new ministers and state ministers have officially taken their oath at Bangabhaban.

Four new ministers and two state ministers took their oath of office at Bangabhaban in the first cabinet reshuffle.

The new appointments include Moin Khan for Local Government, Partha for Information, and Millat for Aviation.
